name: Enrichr_list_libraries
description: List all available Enrichr gene set libraries with statistics. Enrichr has 225+ libraries covering pathways (KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways), gene ontology (GO), transcription factors, diseases, drugs, and more. Optionally filter by keyword in library name. Set species to query the fly, worm, yeast, or fish Enrichr instances; libraries and gene symbols differ per organism.

species.description: Organism instance to query: 'human' (default), 'mouse', 'fly' (FlyEnrichr), 'worm' (WormEnrichr), 'yeast' (YeastEnrichr), or 'fish' (FishEnrichr). Gene set libraries differ per organism, and gene symbols must match that organism's nomenclature.

library_name.description: The gene-set library's name, which is what must be passed to the enrichment call.

num_terms.description: How many gene sets it holds. Enrichment p-values depend on this, so a library with more terms demands a stricter correction.

gene_coverage.description: How many distinct genes the library covers. A gene absent from the library cannot contribute to any enrichment.

genes_per_term.description: Mean set size. Very large sets produce significant overlaps easily.

name: Enrichr_enrich
description: Perform gene set enrichment analysis using Enrichr. Submit a list of genes and get enriched terms from a specific library. Returns ranked terms with p-values, z-scores, combined scores, and overlapping genes. No authentication required. Set species to query the fly, worm, yeast, or fish Enrichr instances; libraries and gene symbols differ per organism.

gene_list.description: List of gene symbols (e.g., ['TP53', 'BRCA1', 'EGFR']). Minimum 1 gene.

library.description: Enrichr library name (default: GO_Biological_Process_2023). Common: GO_Biological_Process_2023, KEGG_2021_Human, Reactome_2022, WikiPathways_2024_Human, MSigDB_Hallmark_2020

top_n.description: Number of top enriched terms to return (default: 10)

species.description: Organism instance to query: 'human' (default), 'mouse', 'fly' (FlyEnrichr), 'worm' (WormEnrichr), 'yeast' (YeastEnrichr), or 'fish' (FishEnrichr). Gene set libraries differ per organism, and gene symbols must match that organism's nomenclature.

library.description: The library the enrichment ran against.

gene_count.description: How many of the submitted genes Enrichr recognised. Lower than what was submitted means genes were silently dropped.

total_terms.description: How many terms the library holds -- the multiple-testing burden behind the adjusted p-values.

enriched_terms.description: The enriched terms with their statistics.

items.description: One enriched term with its statistics.

adjusted_p_value.description: After Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the library. The one to read.

combined_score.description: Enrichr's own ranking score. Not a probability and not comparable between libraries.

overlapping_genes.description: Which submitted genes are in the term.

rank.description: The term's position in Enrichr's ranking. Ranked by combined_score, NOT by adjusted p-value, so rank 1 is not necessarily the most significant term.

overlap_count.description: How many of the submitted genes are in the term. A 'significant' term resting on two genes is not the same finding as one resting on twenty, and the p-value alone does not say which.

z_score.description: Deviation of the term's rank from the rank expected by chance. Enrichr's combined_score is log(p) multiplied by this, so a high combined score can come from either factor.

name: Enrichr_get_top_enriched
description: Get top enriched terms across multiple libraries simultaneously. Submit a gene list and get the most significant pathways, processes, and functions from GO, KEGG, Reactome, and WikiPathways in one call. Ideal for quick functional annotation overview. Set species to query the fly, worm, yeast, or fish Enrichr instances; libraries and gene symbols differ per organism.

libraries.description: Libraries to query (default: GO_Biological_Process_2023, KEGG_2021_Human, Reactome_2022, WikiPathways_2024_Human)

top_n.description: Number of top terms per library (default: 5)

species.description: Organism instance to query: 'human' (default), 'mouse', 'fly' (FlyEnrichr), 'worm' (WormEnrichr), 'yeast' (YeastEnrichr), or 'fish' (FishEnrichr). Gene set libraries differ per organism, and gene symbols must match that organism's nomenclature.

gene_count.description: How many submitted genes Enrichr recognised.

results_by_library.description: The enrichment per library, KEYED BY LIBRARY NAME -- 'KEGG_2021_Human', 'GO_Biological_Process_2023'. Which keys appear depends on what was requested, so read it as a map.

total_terms.description: How many terms that library holds -- the correction burden behind the adjusted p-values below.

top_terms.description: The most enriched terms, best first.

p_value.description: Nominal p-value from the exact test.

adjusted_p_value.description: After Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the library. This is the one to read; the nominal p ignores that hundreds of terms were tested.

combined_score.description: Enrichr's own ranking score, log(p) times the z-score of the deviation from expected rank. Not a probability and not comparable between libraries.

overlapping_genes.description: Which of the submitted genes are in the term. A 'significant' term resting on two genes is not the same finding as one resting on twenty.

name: Enrichr_gene_to_genesets
description: Reverse gene-to-geneset membership lookup. Given ONE gene symbol, return every Enrichr term/gene-set (by name) that contains it, broken down across all ~243 Enrichr libraries (KEGG/Reactome/WikiPathways pathways, GO terms, transcription-factor target sets, disease/drug signatures, GeneSigDB publication tables, etc.). This is the inverse of forward enrichment (which takes a gene list): use it to ask 'what known programs/signatures is gene X a member of?' without running an enrichment. Returns a dict of library_name -> list of term/gene-set names containing the gene. Set include_metadata=true to also return per-library category/description metadata. No authentication required. Set species to query the fly, worm, yeast, or fish Enrichr instances; libraries and gene symbols differ per organism.

gene.description: A single official HGNC gene symbol (e.g., 'STAT3', 'BRCA1'). Case-sensitive; use the canonical symbol.

include_metadata.description: If true, also return library category/description metadata (Enrichr setup=true). Default: false.

max_terms_per_library.description: Optional cap on the number of term names returned per library (0 = no cap, return all). Default: 0.

species.description: Organism instance to query: 'human' (default), 'mouse', 'fly' (FlyEnrichr), 'worm' (WormEnrichr), 'yeast' (YeastEnrichr), or 'fish' (FishEnrichr). Gene set libraries differ per organism, and gene symbols must match that organism's nomenclature.

num_libraries.description: Number of Enrichr libraries in which the gene appears in at least one term

total_gene_sets.description: Total number of term/gene-set memberships across all libraries

libraries.description: Map of library_name -> list of term/gene-set names in that library containing the gene
